arxiv-1712-10212.title: Scale effects and the formation of polarization vortices in tetragonal ferroelectrics
arxiv-1712-10212.creator: Ananya Renuka Balakrishna, John E. Huber
arxiv-1712-10212.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Ananya Renuka Balakrishna, John E. Huber. Vortices consisting of 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} quadrant domains are rarely observed in ferroelectrics. Although experiments show polarization flux closures with stripe domains, it is as yet unclear why pure single vortices are not commonly observed. Here we model and explore the energy of polarization patterns with vortex and stripe domains, formed on the square cross-section of a barium titanate nanowire. Using phase-field simulations, we calculate the associated energy of polarization patterns as a function of nanowire width.

arxiv-2308-10744.title: Fermionic theory of nonequilibrium steady states
arxiv-2308-10744.creator: Eric De Giuli, Masanari Shimada
arxiv-2308-10744.description: Abstract As the quantification of metabolism, nonequilibrium steady states play a central role in living matter, but are beyond the purview of equilibrium statistical mechanics. Here we develop a fermionic theory of nonequilibrium steady states in continuous-time Markovian systems, generalizing Boltzmann-Gibbs statistical mechanics to this case. The response to an arbitrary perturbation is computed, and simplified in canonical cases.

arxiv-2402-09765.title: Reinforcement Learning for Solving Stochastic Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
arxiv-2402-09765.creator: Zangir Iklassov, Ikboljon Sobirov, Ruben Solozabal, Martin Takáč
arxiv-2402-09765.description: Abstract This paper introduces a reinforcement learning approach to optimize the Stochastic Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (SVRP), focusing on reducing travel costs in goods delivery. We develop a novel SVRP formulation that accounts for uncertain travel costs and demands, alongside specific customer time windows. An attention-based neural network trained through reinforcement learning is employed to minimize routing costs.

arxiv-2511-02475.title: Lost in Code Generation: Reimagining the Role of Software Models in AI-driven Software Engineering
arxiv-2511-02475.creator: Jürgen Cito, Dominik Bork
arxiv-2511-02475.description: Abstract . Generative AI enables rapid “vibe coding," where natural language prompts yield working software systems. While this lowers barriers to software creation, it also collapses the boundary between prototypes and engineered software, leading to fragile systems that lack robustness, security, and maintainability. We argue that this shift motivates a reimagining of software models.

pmc-13195641.title: Reversible Thickness Engineering in Amorphous In2O3 Transistors
pmc-13195641.creator: Yi-Yu Pan, Chu-Hsiu Hsu, Robert Tseng, Sung-Tsun Wang, Yu-Cheng Chang, Shih-Chieh Chen, Takashi Kimura, Yann-Wen Lan, Der-Hsien Lien
pmc-13195641.description: Amorphous oxide semiconductors offer a unique platform for versatile device processing, as their noncrystalline nature eliminates the requirement for lattice matching at the interface and enables low-temperature regrowth and isotropic processing. pmc-13266246.creator: Jiawei Wang, Zhenzhen Wang, Wanting Zhao, Haomin Chen, Bowen Lu, Yingxiang Shao, Yanyan Zheng, Shanshan Liu, Meng Wang, Lin Fang, Huizhong Li, Praveen Neeli, Hui Tian, Gang Wang, Dafei Chai

V-domain Ig suppressor of T-cell activation (VISTA), an inhibitory immune checkpoint enriched in myeloid cells and regulatory T cells (Tregs), represents a critical barrier to effective antitumor immunity.

pmc-13336987.title: Cholesterol‐Mediated Metabolic‐mechanotransductive Crosstalk Orchestrates Castration Resistance in Prostate Cancer
pmc-13336987.creator: Shaojie Liu, Chao Xu, Jun Jiang, Limin He, Yike Zhou, Zhengxuan Li, Yu Li, Keying Zhang, Fa Yang, Tong Lu, Hongtao Song, Hai Zhu, Zhihao Hu, Xiaolong Zhao, Kai Gan, Hongji Li, Bo Yang, Rui Zhang, Weihong Wen, Donghui Han, Weijun Qin
pmc-13336987.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Biophysical microenvironment fuels therapeutic resistance, yet the contribution of matrix stiffness to castration‐resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) remains poorly understood. In this study, we established a metabolic‐mechanotransductive crosstalk wherein cholesterol‐driven stromal reprogramming amplifies CRPC progression. Mechanistically, full androgen deprivation (FAD) induces cholesterol metabolic rewiring in prostate cancer (PCa) cells that orchestrates the CH25H‐dependent phenotype transformation of cancer‐associated fibroblast (CAF) into myofibroblastic CAF (myCAF).

pmc-13642118.description: Accurate detection of nanoparticles in liquids is essential across drug delivery, diagnostics, and environmental monitoring.
